THE IDEA / 01

Less screen time.
More real life.

Information should be there when you need it, and out of the way when you don't. Aira is being designed around a simple idea: your world comes first.

THE DESIGN / 03

Technology that
stays out of the way.

Our hardware goals are focused on comfort, clarity and responsible use.

01 / OPTICS◉

Discreet display.

A transparent near-eye display designed to minimize external light leakage. Optical performance is yet to be validated.

02 / CONTROL✧

Natural controls.

Voice, smartphone controls and experimental hand gestures. Choose what feels right for you.

03 / PRIVACY▣

You're in control.

On-demand visual assistance, opt-in conversation capture and planned hardware activity indicators.

DESIGNED FOR THE EVERYDAY

Look up.
Stay present.

From a quick translation to a question about what you see, Aira is designed for short, helpful interactions rather than another screen to stare at.

OUR JOURNEY / 04

From idea to eyewear.

An early-stage technology project in Abu Dhabi, UAE. Here's where we are today.

01SOFTWARE PROTOTYPE

Aira OS

Development software with AI integration, display simulation, phone controls and experimental gestures.

02NEXT

Optical prototype

Source compatible optics, validate the physical display and develop an initial frame.

03PLANNED

Product validation

Test comfort, privacy, safety and reliability with qualified partners before any commercial launch.
